title: A new default for text, and a new route for FLUX
summary:
GPT-5 Nano became the default text model, FLUX gained a fallback route, and two community projects joined the listings.

The `openai` text model now maps to GPT-5 Nano, while `openai-fast` stays on GPT-4.1 Nano. FLUX image requests now try registered ComfyUI servers first, then Cloudflare Flux and Dreamshaper as fallbacks, with progress reporting each fallback. The same model-configuration work added a `mistral-romance` mapping and adjusted other provider mappings.

Public model listings now exclude hidden models and provider-specific original names, with non-community models sorted first. Several older model entries were removed, and `openai-large` moved from the flower tier to the seed tier.

The project listings added a bilingual AI Image Generator with prompt optimization and progress display, plus AI Agent Portal, a multi-agent development environment with coding, content, and canvas modes.

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano becomes default
highlights.text: Requests using the `openai` model now select GPT-5 Nano. Use `openai-fast` if you want to keep using GPT-4.1 Nano. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai).
